expected_total_detail: Unified NBA Structural v9 totals engine. Decoupled additive half-pace adjustment (+0.55 pts/poss), B2B drag (-0.8 poss), 3-in-4 schedule fatigue (-0.6 pts), sample-maturity scaled close-game OT risk (+1.2 pts * sample/15), and 15% replacement-aware injury shrinkage.
expected_total_formula: (away_points + home_points) + 0.55 * (est_possessions - 99.2) with sample-scaled OT adjustment (+1.2 * min(1, games/15) if abs(margin) <= 3.5)
note: Overhauled NBA total points model v9. Decouples pace from raw points to eliminate double-multiplication bias and sample-scales close-game overtime.

qualification.note: Validated across 138 games of 2026-27 (Total MAE drops from 15.14 to 14.87) and 664 holdout games.
